versos.hebraico: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ אַל־תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה׃

controles.web: Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.
controles.kjv: Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
controles.livre: Não te irrites com os malfeitores, nem tenhas inveja dos que praticam perversidade.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן׃

controles.web: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.
controles.kjv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
controles.livre: Porque assim como a erva, eles logo serão cortados; e como a verdura eles cairão.

versos.hebraico: בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה׃

controles.web: Trust in Yahweh, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.
controles.kjv: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
controles.livre: Confia no SENHOR, e faze o bem; habita a terra, e te alimentarás em segurança.

versos.hebraico: וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל־יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן־לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ׃

controles.web: Also delight yourself in Yahweh, and he will give you the desires of your heart.
controles.kjv: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
controles.livre: E agrada-te no SENHOR; e ele te dará os pedidos de teu coração.

versos.hebraico: גּ֣וֹל עַל־יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

controles.web: Commit your way to Yahweh. Trust also in him, and he will do this:
controles.kjv: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.
controles.livre: Conduz teu caminho ao SENHOR, e confia nele; e ele lhe fará o bem.

versos.hebraico: וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃

controles.web: he will make your righteousness go out as the light, and your justice as the noon day sun.
controles.kjv: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
controles.livre: E ele manifestará tua justiça como a luz; e teu direito como o sol do meio-dia.

versos.hebraico: דּ֤וֹם׀ לַיהוָה֮ וְהִתְח֪וֹלֵ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל־תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Rest in Yahweh, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.
controles.kjv: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
controles.livre: Descansa-te no SENHOR, e espera por ele; não te irrites contra aquele cujo caminho prospera, nem com o homem que planeja maldades.

versos.hebraico: הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל־תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ־לְהָרֵֽעַ׃

controles.web: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret, it leads only to evildoing.
controles.kjv: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
controles.livre: Detém a ira, abandona o furor; não te irrites de maneira alguma para fazer o mal.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for Yahweh shall inherit the land.
controles.kjv: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.
controles.livre: Porque os malfeitores serão exterminados; mas os que esperam no SENHOR herdarão a terra.

versos.hebraico: וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל־מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃

controles.web: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.
controles.kjv: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.
controles.livre: E ainda um pouco, e o perverso não mais existirá ; e tu olharás para o lugar dele, e ele não aparecerá .

versos.hebraico: וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל־רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם׃

controles.web: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
controles.kjv: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
controles.livre: Mas os mansos herdarão a terra, e se agradarão com muita paz.

versos.hebraico: זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו׃

controles.web: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.
controles.kjv: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
controles.livre: O perverso trama contra o justo, e range seus dentes contra ele.

versos.hebraico: אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק־ל֑וֹ כִּֽי־רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי־יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ׃

controles.web: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.
controles.kjv: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
controles.livre: O Senhor ri dele, porque vê que já vem o dia dele.

versos.hebraico: חֶ֤רֶב׀ פָּֽתְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֪וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־דָֽרֶךְ׃

controles.web: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.
controles.kjv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.
controles.livre: O perversos pegarão a espada e armarão seu arco, para abaterem ao miserável e necessitado, para matarem os corretos no caminho.

versos.hebraico: חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה׃

controles.web: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.
controles.kjv: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
controles.livre: Mas sua espada entrará em seus corações, e seus arcos serão quebrados.

versos.hebraico: טוֹב־מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

controles.web: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.
controles.kjv: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.
controles.livre: O pouco que o justo tem é melhor do que a riqueza de muitos perversos.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but Yahweh upholds the righteous.
controles.kjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.
controles.livre: Porque os braços dos perversos serão quebrados, mas o SENHOR sustenta os justos.

versos.hebraico: יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה׃

controles.web: Yahweh knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.
controles.kjv: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
controles.livre: O SENHOR conhece os dias dos corretos, e a herança deles permanecerá para sempre.

versos.hebraico: לֹֽא־יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃

controles.web: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
controles.kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
controles.livre: Eles não serão envergonhados no tempo mau, e terão fartura nos dias de fome.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים׀ יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ׃

controles.web: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of Yahweh shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.
controles.kjv: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
controles.livre: Mas os perversos perecerão, e os inimigos do SENHOR desaparecerão tal como as melhores partes dos cordeiros; eles de desfarão na fumaça.

versos.hebraico: לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן׃

controles.web: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.
controles.kjv: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
controles.livre: O perverso toma emprestado, e paga de volta; mas o justo se compadece e dá.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃

controles.web: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.
controles.kjv: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.
controles.livre: Porque os que são por ele abençoados herdarão a terra; mas os que são por ele amaldiçoados serão removidos.

versos.hebraico: מֵ֭יְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי־גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ׃

controles.web: A man’s goings are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
controles.kjv: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.
controles.livre: Os passos do homem justo são preparados pelo SENHOR; e ele tem prazer em seu caminho.

versos.hebraico: כִּֽי־יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא־יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי־יְ֝הוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for Yahweh holds him up with his hand.
controles.kjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.
controles.livre: Quando cai, ele não fica derrubado, pois o SENHOR sustenta a sua mão.

versos.hebraico: נַ֤עַר׀ הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם־זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא־רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־לָֽחֶם׃

controles.web: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.
controles.kjv: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
controles.livre: Eu já fui jovem, e já envelheci; mas nunca vi o justo desamparado, nem a sua semente a pedir pão.

versos.hebraico: כָּל־הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה׃

controles.web: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His seed is blessed.
controles.kjv: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.
controles.livre: O dia todo ele se compadece, e empresta; e sua semente é abençoada.

versos.hebraico: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.
controles.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
controles.livre: Afasta-te do mal, e faze o bem; e faça sua habitação eterna.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא־יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת׃

controles.web: For Yahweh loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.
controles.kjv: For the Lord loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
controles.livre: Porque o SENHOR ama o juízo, e não desampara a seus santos: eles estão guardados para sempre; mas a semente dos perversos será removida.

versos.hebraico: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.
controles.kjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
controles.livre: Os justos herdarão a terra, e para sempre nela habitarão.

versos.hebraico: פִּֽי־צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

controles.web: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.
controles.kjv: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
controles.livre: A boca do justo fala de sabedoria, e sua língua fala do bom juízo.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃

controles.web: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.
controles.kjv: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
controles.livre: A Lei de seu Deus está em seu coração; seus passos não serão abalados.

versos.hebraico: צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

controles.web: The wicked watches the righteous, and seeks to kill him.
controles.kjv: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
controles.livre: O perverso espia ao justo, e procura matá-lo.

versos.hebraico: יְ֭הוָה לֹא־יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
controles.kjv: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
controles.livre: Mas o SENHOR não o deixa em suas mãos; nem também o condenará, quando for julgado.

versos.hebraico: קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל־יְהוָ֨ה׀ וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃

controles.web: Wait for Yahweh, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.
controles.kjv: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.
controles.livre: Espera no SENHOR, guarda o seu caminho, e ele te exaltará, para herdares a terra; tu verás que os perversos serão removidos.

versos.hebraico: רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן׃

controles.web: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.
controles.kjv: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
controles.livre: Eu vi ao perverso violento crescer como a árvore verde, natural da terra.

versos.hebraico: וַ֭יַּֽעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וָֽ֝אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא׃

controles.web: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.
controles.kjv: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
controles.livre: Porém ele já foi embora, e eis que ele não existe mais ; eu o procurei, e não foi achado.

versos.hebraico: שְׁמָר־תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי־אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

controles.web: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.
controles.kjv: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.
controles.livre: Olha ao sincero, e vê o correto; porque o fim de tal homem é a paz.

versos.hebraico: וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה׃

controles.web: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.
controles.kjv: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
controles.livre: Mas os transgressores serão juntamente destruídos; o fim dos perversos será eliminado.

versos.hebraico: וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהוָ֑ה מָֽ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה׃

controles.web: But the salvation of the righteous is from Yahweh. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.
controles.kjv: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.
controles.livre: Porém a salvação dos justos vem do SENHOR, que é a força deles no tempo de angústia.

versos.hebraico: וַֽיַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי־חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ׃

controles.web: Yahweh helps them, and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked, and saves them, Because they have taken refuge in him.
controles.kjv: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
controles.livre: E o SENHOR os socorrerá, e os livrará; ele os livrará dos perversos, e os salvará, porque nele confiam.
